assumptions.simulationStarts: Monday, new wallet, zero opening balance; Today's mock 248 is excluded
assumptions.weekStarts: Monday in the user's local calendar
assumptions.currentStreakInterpretation: 7 consecutive active local days; once per continuous streak instance, not once every 7 days
assumptions.currentStreakCaveat: Qualification is not implemented; arbitrary new streak IDs have no daily product cap. The safe-integer balance guard is not an economy cap.
assumptions.activeDayQualification: At least one actual meal log, personalized water-goal completion, or completed workout; no requirement to do all three. Weight alone does not qualify.
assumptions.dailyMealsQualification: All user-planned meal occasions logged; no fixed meal count, calorie target, or food-intake outcome
assumptions.proposedDailyTrackingQualification: One qualified active day; replaces an all-categories checklist interpretation
assumptions.currentDailyTrackingQualification: Profile-specific complete tracking days; never assumed on every active day

principles.casualProgress: Entry purchase in the first active week under the modeled schedule
principles.powerUserSpread: Approximately 2.3x Casual, from more active days and varied activity rather than repeated entries

mealLogged.reason: First meal log only; additional food entries do not multiply income

dailyMealsCompleted.reason: Small optional completeness bonus, without a required meal count

waterGoalCompleted.reason: A useful but optional personalized goal

workoutCompleted.reason: Recognize training without making it dominate

weightLogged.reason: No extra currency for daily weighing

dailyTrackingCompleted.reason: An inclusive active-day base, not an all-features checklist

activeDayMilestones.identity: walletId + lifetimeActiveDays + threshold; once per wallet and threshold
activeDayMilestones.after365: No automatic repeat bonus proposed; revisit with actual usage data

welcomeReward.trigger: First qualifying active day, after introducing cosmetic currency
welcomeReward.identity: walletId + welcome-v1; once, retained across reinstall/re-onboarding
